detail.longDescription: "Today, I’m pleased to announce Voices, a package that turns AI writing instructions into Vale rules. It builds on Std, announced alongside it today, and on the Vale v3.20 features that post introduces. The starting material comes from the output-style catalog, a collection of prompts that each describe a voice. And the approach is the prose half of an argument already being won for code. Evil Martians recommend moving agent rules out of AGENTS.md and into hooks. A rule encoded as a tool is a rule the model can’t forget. Swizec Teller and Factory reached the same place for code review. Compared to a prompt, rules are cheaper, verifiable, cumulative, and measurable. In the following sections, we’ll look at each claim in turn, with real model output as the evidence." https:// vale.sh/blog/voices # TechnicalWriting # AI # AISlop # Vale # AIAgents # AgenticAI # SoftwareDocumentation
